task_description: Add a first-class song-planner agent package (canonical planning methodology + thin agent + SOP 09 + SONG BRIEF template + sample brief) that produces an approvable Song Brief before lyrics, AND a guided/collaborative lyric-writing mode on the existing songwriter+critic (section-by-section propose -> self-flag via critique.md's full 12-category rubric -> confirm). Both framed under one shared 'Collaborative / Guided Mode' concept. Strict constraint: guided modes are a new INTERACTION MODE over existing core/methodology; NO craft logic may be duplicated — everything references core/methodology/songwriting.md and core/methodology/critique.md. Docs (README, CHANGELOG, WORKFLOW_DIAGRAM, SONGWRITING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE) updated. Work on a new branch off main; do not push or open a PR.

review.followup: Both non-blocking v1 issues fixed in commit bc2ca6b (added Intro/Outro row to guided-mode emphasis table; de-duplicated SOP 01/agent per-section guidance via a pointer to the authoritative agent mapping).

verification.summary: Markdown-only toolkit; no build/test suite (validate-song.py out of scope). Structural verification: all 4 new files exist; all #[[file:]] includes in song-planner.md and songwriter.md resolve on disk; song-planning.md has 37 references to canonical craft files and 0 redefined scoring scales (single-source-of-truth held); SOP 09 template and sample brief both carry the 12 brief sections in order; sample brief contains no verse/chorus lyric tags (conceptual only); README shows 6 agents / 7 method files / 9 SOPs with the song-planner row + SOP 09 row + guided-mode paragraph; CHANGELOG [Unreleased]/Added has both package + guided-mode bullets; WORKFLOW_DIAGRAM shows the PLAN -> [Song Brief] -> WRITE(guided) seam and the song-planner node.
